name: Count Remington Ridgewell
summary: In Stormwind Keep, Count Remington Ridgewell tends a collection fit for a noble’s pride. A wealthy human in the House of Nobles, he gathers rare artifacts, heirlooms, and fine art.

sections.title: A Connoisseur of Antiquities
sections.body: Count Remington Ridgewell favors antiquities over military campaigns or local uprisings. His family’s personal museum holds jewelry and artifacts, and he spends his wealth gathering relics from fallen civilizations and houses across Azeroth. To fill his gallery, he finances adventurers and sends field agents such as Mayara Brightwing to retrieve rare objects from dangerous ruins, from Alterac’s mountain redoubts to the volcanic wastes of the Burning Steppes.

faq.answer: Count Remington Ridgewell is a human noble and antiquities collector in Stormwind Keep’s Petitioner's Chamber. He spends his family fortune on relics, jewels, and art from across the world.

faq.q: What artifacts does Count Ridgewell seek?
faq.answer: Ridgewell seeks lost heirlooms for his museum. Among them are the Perenolde Tiara from Alterac’s ruins and historical Dark Iron dwarf treasures from the Ruins of Thaurissan.
Mayara Brightwing is an agent employed by Count Ridgewell. He sent her to the Burning Steppes to scout for antiquities in the ancient Ruins of Thaurissan.

faq.q: Where can Count Remington Ridgewell be found?
faq.answer: Count Remington Ridgewell can be found in the Petitioner's Chamber inside Stormwind Keep, among nobles and dignitaries seeking an audience with the royal court.

angles.text: As an Alliance mercenary, you may find Count Ridgewell a lucrative patron; he pays well for relics recovered from fallen northern kingdoms and lost dwarven cities.
As a human, you can see how Stormwind’s House of Nobles prizes cultural standing and art collecting, even amid the kingdom’s political instability.
